atoms.reason: Triple-proposal consensus and the load-bearing feature of the change. The video → photo → message cascade adds capability while explicitly preserving the existing sendPhoto path, so it is correct, low-cost, and high-impact. Specificity is good; minor simplicity hit from added branching.

Guarded is_file()/read_bytes() validation with silent fall-through to the photo path is the primary safety net for the cascade in DA-001. High risk-reduction value; cheap and feasible. Impact is moderate since it is robustness rather than new behavior.

Matches Telegram's sendVideo contract exactly (multipart/form-data, 'video' field, filename incident.mp4, video/mp4 MIME, reused chat_id/caption). Highly specific and verifiable via mocked HTTP. Simplicity is slightly lower due to multipart assembly (medium cost), which DA-008 helps contain.

penalties: conflicts with DA-005 (high impact); strict description source can yield empty captions
atoms.reason: Two-proposal support and simple, but directly conflicts with DA-005. Strictly binding the caption to bridge_output.description risks sending captionless videos when description is empty, lowering correctness and risk_reduction. Modify to keep the description-first intent while adopting DA-005's fallback; assuming bridge_output.description and payload.description are the same field, this folds into DA-005.

Resolves the DA-004/DA-005 conflict in the more robust direction: use payload.description when present, else fall back to self._format(payload), guaranteeing an informative caption. Single-proposal origin but it is the recommended reconciliation; reuses an existing formatter so cost stays low.

Consensus testing atom that locks in the cascade contract: a valid-video case asserting the sendVideo URL, multipart body, video bytes, and caption, plus a None/missing-path case asserting the sendPhoto fallback. Strong risk-reduction; medium effort but directly guards the riskiest behaviors of DA-001/DA-003.

Routing the sendVideo call through the existing _post_with_retries/_http_post injection preserves retry semantics, content-type handling, and mockability, and avoids a parallel HTTP path. Strong consistency and risk-reduction value at low cost; specificity slightly lower as it depends on existing internals behaving identically for multipart.

A _build_video_multipart helper mirroring _build_photo_multipart keeps report() focused on decision logic and avoids duplicated assembly, supporting DA-003. It is a quality/structure improvement rather than functional behavior, so impact is moderate and it adds a small amount of code (slight simplicity cost).

penalties: risks inconsistency with the existing photo-URL construction convention
atoms.reason: Low-stakes, easily reversible style choice. Inlining the sendVideo URL keeps the diff localized, but dogmatically avoiding a constant can diverge from how the existing sendPhoto URL is built. Modify to follow whatever the established convention is (constant if photo uses one, inline otherwise); impact and risk-reduction are inherently low either way.
